visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a bright red storefront sign displaying white characters and a celebratory banner. The lighting is natural daylight, showing a clean urban street environment. (2) A close-up shot features a sizzling steak on a black iron plate, topped with black pepper sauce, accompanied by flat noodles and a fried egg. Steam rises visibly from the hot plate. (3) The scene shifts to a buffet area where various pizzas are arranged on white plates. A hand scoops a rich curry sauce containing meat and carrots, then transitions to a bowl of braised pork rice. (4) Footage shows self-service stations including a red Coca-Cola soda fountain, a coffee machine, and a vanilla soft-serve ice cream dispenser. (5) A young man wearing glasses and a grey shirt is seen eating soft-serve ice cream from a metal cup. The background is a clean, modern indoor restaurant setting with bright artificial lighting. (6) An order form and menu are shown, listing various steak options and prices. A person uses a fork and knife to cut into a medium-cooked steak, revealing a pink interior. (7) A close-up of a shelf holding various sauce bottles including A1 steak sauce and B.B. spicy sauce. (8) The man is seen eating noodles coated in sauce, followed by a shot of him looking directly at the camera with a surprised expression and a question mark emoji overlay. (9) Final shots include a scoop of corn soup, a fresh salad plate, and sliced oranges and guava in a refrigerated display. The video ends with a full table spread of food including steaks, soups, and sides.
